searchText: To confirm: Is OpenEthereum officially a dead project? <timbeiko> A team is still contributing to it but I’m not aware of the exact status and it’s worth noting they have not taken part in merge testing efforts. <@!552133098075193354> <@!420951281910284289> Is there a community call right now?
